sections.title: AI Services for Seattle Manufacturers
sections.description: Industrial AI built specifically for Seattle's aerospace, semiconductor, and maritime manufacturing ecosystem.

items.title: Aerospace Manufacturing AI
items.description: Seattle is the US commercial aerospace capital — Boeing's Everett facility (largest building by volume in the world) and its Puget Sound manufacturing complex, Spirit AeroSystems, Hexcel, and hundreds of aerospace tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers. Aircraft component inspection AI: computer vision systems detecting surface defects, dimensional deviations, and assembly anomalies on aircraft structures, composites, and precision-machined components — at the accuracy standards that airworthiness certification requires. Predictive maintenance for aerospace tooling and fixtures: ML models predicting tooling wear and calibration drift from CNC machine sensor data, preventing unplanned production interruptions. Quality records intelligence: NLP extracting structured data from inspection records, material certifications, and non-conformance reports. Cost: $65,000–$180,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | AS9100 quality context.
items.label: Aerospace

items.title: Semiconductor and Electronics Manufacturing AI
items.description: Seattle's semiconductor presence — Micron Technology's memory design center, Intel's Everett and Hillsboro operations (accessible market), Microsoft's silicon design group — creates demand for semiconductor manufacturing AI. Computer vision for wafer and die inspection, yield prediction ML from process parameter data, and equipment anomaly detection from fab sensor telemetry are the primary semiconductor AI applications. Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks.
items.label: Semiconductor

items.title: Shipbuilding and Marine Operations AI
items.description: Puget Sound's shipbuilding and marine industry — Vigor Industrial, BAE Systems' shipyard, and Washington's substantial commercial fishing fleet — creates distinctive maritime AI requirements: hull inspection from underwater drone imagery, predictive maintenance for marine diesel engines, and logistics optimization for Seattle's busy port operations. Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks.
items.label: Shipbuilding

items.title: Supply Chain Intelligence for Seattle Manufacturers
items.description: Seattle's aerospace supply chains are among the most complex in US manufacturing — with tier-1, tier-2, and tier-3 suppliers distributed globally but with significant Pacific Northwest concentration. ML supply chain disruption prediction, supplier risk scoring, and demand forecasting for aerospace components support the visibility that complex aerospace supply chains require. Cost: $45,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks.
items.label: Supply Chain

items.title: Quality Records Intelligence (NLP)
items.description: NLP extracting structured data from inspection records, material certifications, and non-conformance reports at the volume that Boeing's production programs generate. Cost: $35,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Quality Records
